name: IKEA Kallax shelf
description: Any-size KALLAX cube shelf. 1x1 = 42x42, each extra cube +35 cm, depth 39 cm. Works lying or standing (swap cols/rows). The ikea-kallax-* assets are the exact products IKEA Israel sells (with price + item no.).

source.notes: Dimensions from IKEA product sheets. Inserts 33x37x33, DRÖNA box 33x38x33, underframe modelled 17.5 high.

inserts.description: per cube, rows top→bottom, e.g. [["door-left", ""], ["drawers", "box"]]: door-left | door-right | drawers | shelf | divider | box (DRÖNA) | ""

underframe.description: true = stands on a KALLAX underframe (+17.5 cm)
